colophons.ROM: Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
colophons.1CO: The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.
colophons.2CO: The second epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, a city of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.
colophons.GAL: Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
colophons.EPH: Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
colophons.PHP: It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
colophons.COL: Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.
colophons.1TH: The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
colophons.2TH: The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
colophons.1TI: The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
colophons.2TI: The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
colophons.TIT: It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
colophons.PHM: Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus, a servant.
colophons.HEB: Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
